description: List observed implementations from the instances index. Optional filters: protocol (id or alias), type (origin, harness, sdk, venue, authority, agent), archetype, org (org_id), q (substring), limit (1–20, default 10). Returns { matched, returned, license, items } with id, org_id, name, type, url, implements, archetypes, observed, note, source, and implementations (protocol_id, role, support_level, probe_mode, status, checked_on; narrowed to the requested protocol when one was given).

protocol.description: protocol id or alias; narrows items and their implementations

q.description: case-insensitive substring over id, name, org_id, and note

type.description: instance type: origin, harness, sdk, venue, authority, or agent

name: instances
title: List observed implementations
